### 🟡 Changes recommended Streaming drops refusal text when a chunk has empty-string content and a nonempty refusal, making the streamed output inconsistent with the completed turn.
1 open issue - [Handle empty content when extracting streamed refusal text](https://github.com/posit-dev/chatlas/pull/484#discussion_r4519559395) · New
What changed in this PR This PR preserves refusal text in the OpenAI Chat Completions provider and its subclasses, allowing existing content-moderation handling to report refusals instead of empty successful responses. **Changes:** - Yield streamed refusal fragments and preserve refusal text in completed turns. - Classify content-free refusals ending in `stop` as `content_filter`. - Add regression tests for completed, structured-output, and streamed refusals. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tests/​test_provider_openai_completions.py | Adds regression coverage for refusal text and moderation handling. | | chatlas/​_provider_openai_completions.py | Preserves refusal text and updates finish-reason classification. |

review_comments.body: A refusal chunk with `content: ""` and a nonempty `refusal` still yields only empty text, because this fallback is reachable only when content is `None`. The completed-turn path already treats both values as absent, so such a stream returns no refusal text even though the final turn contains it. Apply the same empty-content handling here and cover this shape in the streamed-refusal test.
